description: Machine-readable catalog of open standardized legal agreement frameworks. Both computable (Strand A) and reference-only (Strand B) standards. License tags are SPDX identifiers or descriptive strings where no SPDX id applies.

standards.name: Common Paper Mutual NDA
standards.notes: Cover Page (Key Terms) + Standard Terms by reference. First-class Strand A assembler target.

standards.name: Common Paper Cloud Service Agreement
standards.notes: SaaS/cloud services master agreement. Cover Page + Standard Terms model.

standards.name: Common Paper Software License Agreement
standards.notes: On-premise / perpetual software license with cover-page variables.

standards.name: Common Paper Data Processing Agreement
standards.notes: GDPR Art 28 compliant DPA. Cross-links to AI-Act classifiers.

standards.name: Common Paper Business Associate Agreement
standards.notes: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement with cover-page variables.

standards.name: Common Paper Professional Services Agreement
standards.notes: Standard professional services / consulting engagement terms.

standards.name: Common Paper Service Level Agreement
standards.notes: Standard SLA addendum specifying uptime, response times, and remedies.

standards.name: Common Paper Pilot Agreement
standards.notes: Time-limited evaluation / pilot engagement terms.

standards.name: Common Paper Design Partner Agreement
standards.notes: Early-customer design partnership terms including IP ownership and feedback rights.

standards.name: Common Paper Partnership Agreement
standards.notes: Reseller, referral, and technology partnership terms.

standards.name: Common Paper Terms of Service
standards.notes: Customer-facing ToS for B2B SaaS products.

standards.name: Common Paper Language Library
standards.notes: Standardized clause library for mixing into Custom Paper Cover Pages.

standards.name: Common Paper Order Form
standards.notes: Standard Order Form for subscription services and one-time purchases.

standards.name: Common Paper Statement of Work
standards.notes: SOW addendum for project-scoped deliverables under a PSA.

standards.name: Common Paper Term Sheet
standards.notes: Non-binding commercial term sheet for structuring negotiations.

standards.name: Common Paper Letter of Intent
standards.notes: Non-binding LOI for strategic relationships and M&A preliminary steps.

standards.name: Common Paper One-Way NDA
standards.notes: Unilateral confidentiality agreement for one-direction disclosure.

standards.name: Common Paper AI Addendum
standards.notes: AI data-use addendum (Aug 2025). Cover-page vars: train_on_customer_data, model_improvement, retention_window, output_ownership, subprocessor_ai. Cross-links: build_tdm_reservation (art-202), check_ai_act_art50_marking (art-126), run_ai_act_highrisk_fit (art-64). First-class AI-era assembler target for P2.5.

standards.name: Bonterms Mutual NDA
standards.notes: Bonterms Standard Agreement + Additional Terms model. CC BY-ND 4.0: verbatim redistribution permitted; customization via Additional Terms layer only (never edit the body).

standards.name: Bonterms Cloud Terms
standards.notes: Standard SaaS/cloud services terms designed for enterprise use. Paired with Provider-Specific Additional Terms.

standards.name: Bonterms SLA
standards.notes: Bonterms Service Level Agreement addendum for uptime and support commitments.

standards.name: Bonterms Professional Services Agreement
standards.notes: Standard PSA for consulting and professional services engagements.

standards.name: Bonterms Business Associate Agreement
standards.notes: HIPAA BAA (Oct 2024). Covers protected health information handling for covered entities.

standards.name: Bonterms Software License Terms
standards.notes: On-premise software license terms (Sep 2025). Standard Agreement + Additional Terms model.

standards.name: Bonterms Reseller and Marketplace Agreement
standards.notes: Reseller and marketplace distribution terms (Sep 2025). Covers channel and indirect sales.

standards.name: Bonterms Climate Addendum
standards.notes: Sustainability and climate commitments addendum (Feb 2025). Covers emissions reporting and net-zero commitments.

standards.name: oneNDA
standards.notes: Single-page standardized mutual NDA with fixed clause body and variable blanks. Widely adopted as a 'sign once, use everywhere' NDA.

standards.name: oneNDA M&A
standards.notes: oneNDA variant for mergers and acquisitions contexts with additional clauses for deal confidentiality.

standards.name: oneDPA
standards.notes: Standardized GDPR Data Processing Agreement in the oneNDA family. Fixed clause body covering Art 28 mandatory requirements.

standards.name: oneSaaS
standards.notes: 52 canonical SaaS clauses taxonomy (Feb 2025). Comprehensive clause library for SaaS agreements; useful as a coverage taxonomy for the P1 clause-coverage scorer.

standards.name: Y Combinator SAFE (Post-Money)
standards.notes: Standard post-money valuation cap SAFE. Fixed instrument with blanks for valuation cap, discount rate, and pro-rata rights. CC BY-ND 4.0: verbatim redistribution permitted.

standards.name: Y Combinator SAFE (MFN)
standards.notes: Most-Favored-Nation SAFE for investors without a valuation cap; converts on most favorable terms of future rounds.

standards.name: Y Combinator SAFE (Discount)
standards.notes: Discount-only SAFE with a conversion discount but no valuation cap.

standards.name: EU Model Contractual Clauses for AI (High-Risk)
standards.notes: EU MCC-AI High-Risk template (Mar 2025) for AI Act Chapter III high-risk systems. Covers transparency, risk management, data governance, human oversight, and cybersecurity clauses. Redistribution terms unclear: map and point, never vendor. Cross-links: run_ai_act_highrisk_fit (art-64), classify_agentic_ai_risk (art-67), check_ai_act_art50_marking (art-126). Target for P2.5 map_ai_act_procurement_clauses.

standards.name: EU Model Contractual Clauses for AI (Light)
standards.notes: EU MCC-AI Light template for lower-risk AI systems. Streamlined clause set versus the High-Risk template. Reference-only: link to official Commission source.

standards.name: GSA AI Clause GSAR 552.239-7001
standards.license: US Government work (public domain in the US)
standards.notes: GSA AI clause GSAR 552.239-7001 (Mar 2026). Mandatory for US federal AI procurements. Covers AI system transparency, risk management, and incident reporting. Reference-only: point to acquisition.gov.

standards.name: Accord Project
standards.notes: Open-source executable contract framework. Template triangle: text grammar (Markdown + Cicero markup) + data model (Concerto) + logic (Ergo). Apache-2.0. P0 adopts the triangle structure; Cicero/Ergo runtime deferred to P4.

standards.name: FINOS Common Domain Model (CDM)
standards.notes: Financial asset, event, and contract data model (ex-ISDA CDM, now Linux Foundation FINOS). Community Spec License 1.0. Executable legal representations for derivatives and capital markets. Trade-reporting clusters cross-link here; do not duplicate the financial cluster tooling.

standards.name: OpenAgreements
standards.notes: Open template ecosystem: metadata.yaml recipe produces filled DOCX + contract-api.json. Includes an MCP server for agent-driven template filling. AINumbers adopts the contract-api.json twin pattern from this project.

standards.name: CommonAccord
standards.notes: Git-for-contracts approach: prototype document + deltas (like code commits). Composable clause model. Early-stage research infrastructure.

standards.name: NVCA Model Legal Documents
standards.notes: Industry-standard VC term sheets, stock purchase agreements, investor rights agreements, and related docs. Proprietary: reference only, never vendor.

standards.name: Series Seed Documents
standards.notes: Streamlined seed-stage financing documents: preferred stock purchase agreement, term sheet, and voting agreement. Jurisdiction-specific legal interpretation required: reference-only.

standards.name: Founder Institute FAST Agreement
standards.notes: Founder Advisor Standard Template for advisor equity compensation. Simple, standardized form. Reference-only due to jurisdiction-specific legal considerations.

standards.name: Cooley GO Documents
standards.notes: Startup-focused document forms from Cooley LLP: NDAs, equity plans, offer letters, board consents. Proprietary law firm forms: reference only.

standards.name: LLC Operating Agreement (DIY)
standards.notes: Single-member and multi-member LLC operating agreements. Highly jurisdiction-specific. Reference-only; consult state-specific forms and a licensed attorney.

standards.name: Independent Contractor Agreement (DIY)
standards.notes: Freelancer/contractor agreement covering scope, payment, IP assignment, and classification. Reference-only: misclassification risk requires jurisdiction-specific legal review.

standards.name: Terms of Service / Privacy Policy (DIY)
standards.notes: Consumer-facing website and app terms of service and privacy policy. Highly jurisdiction-specific (GDPR, CCPA, etc.). Reference-only.

standards.name: Lease Agreement (DIY)
standards.notes: Residential and commercial lease agreements. Governed by state landlord-tenant law; forms vary by jurisdiction. Reference-only.
